caption:
If a customer cannot buy at the price you advertise, that is a legal problem, not a marketing one.

Since June 2022 it has been a false or misleading representation under the Competition Act to advertise a price nobody can actually pay. In January the Federal Court of Appeal upheld a $38.9 million penalty over a $1.50 booking fee. The fee was disclosed. It was disclosed too late to matter.

The only charges allowed outside your advertised price are ones a statute charges the buyer. There is no small business exemption.

Swipe through, then walk your own checkout on a phone.
